_about: Batch B7a (Serving front): concepts/openai-server, concepts/renderers-and-chat-templates, concepts/tool-and-reasoning-parsers, concepts/structured-outputs, code/entrypoints-openai-chat-completion-serving, code/entrypoints-cli-serve. Owner: the B7a writer.

api-server.short: The uvicorn + FastAPI process of vllm serve that answers HTTP requests. One by default; several with --api-server-count or data parallelism.
api-server.long: With one API server it runs in the CLI process ({{cite vllm/entrypoints/cli/serve.py:153-156}}); with more, the CLI process spawns ApiServer_i processes ({{cite vllm/v1/utils.py:248-254}}).

serving-class.short: A class in vllm/entrypoints that implements one API, for example OpenAIServingChat for /v1/chat/completions. All derive from BaseServing.
serving-class.long: Base class at {{cite vllm/entrypoints/serve/engine/serving.py:31}}; the generate family shares GenerateBaseServing ({{cite vllm/entrypoints/generate/base/serving.py:129}}).

app-state.short: The FastAPI app.state object of the API server. init_app_state stores the engine client, the renderer and one object per serving class in it.
app-state.long: Filled in {{cite vllm/entrypoints/launchers/api_server/app_state.py:24-176}}; route functions read it, for example request.app.state.openai_serving_chat.

router.short: A FastAPI APIRouter: a group of routes in one module. register_api_routers adds the routers to the app, some only for some tasks or flags.

middleware.short: Code that runs around every HTTP request before the route, for example CORS or the API-key check. vLLM adds it in init_entrypoints_middleware.

chat-template-kwargs.short: Extra variables for the chat template, for example enable_thinking. Request values override --default-chat-template-kwargs; names the template does not use are dropped.

add-generation-prompt.short: A chat template variable (default true) that adds the start of a new assistant turn at the end of the prompt, so the model answers next.
add-generation-prompt.long: Request field at {{cite vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/protocol.py:324-331}}; it cannot be true together with continue_final_message ({{cite vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/protocol.py:1045-1055}}).

token-in-token-out.short: Serving where the client sends token ids and gets token ids back, with no template and no detokenization in the server. vLLM has /inference/v1/generate for it.

tool-choice.short: The request field that says whether the model must call a tool: none, auto, required, or one named function. vLLM enforces required and named with structured outputs.
tool-choice.long: Validation at {{cite vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/protocol.py:959-1043}}; schema for required or named at {{cite vllm/tool_parsers/utils.py:449-490}}.

reasoning-content.short: The thinking text of a reasoning model. With --reasoning-parser, vLLM returns it in the vLLM field reasoning (old name reasoning_content), not in content.
reasoning-content.long: Response field at {{cite vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/protocol.py:79-80}}; old input name renamed at {{cite vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/protocol.py:590-592}}.

structured-output-backend.short: The library that compiles a constraint into a grammar and fills the token bitmask: xgrammar, guidance, outlines or lm-format-enforcer. The default auto picks per request.
structured-output-backend.long: Choices at {{cite vllm/config/structured_outputs.py:11-24}}; auto rules at {{cite vllm/sampling_params.py:1390-1441}}.

grammar-bitmask.short: One bit per vocabulary token, packed in int32 words, for each structured request in a step. A 0 bit means the grammar forbids the token; its logit becomes -inf.

json-schema-response-format.short: The OpenAI field response_format of type json_schema. vLLM turns it into a structured outputs json constraint, so the answer must match the schema.
